units.function: Embedded-Postgres regression tests for cross-Agent reassignment while another Agent owns an Issue execution lock, including deferral behind a running holder and optimistic cancellation protection when a queued holder is concurrently claimed.
units.dependencyDirection: heartbeatService reads mutable Issue execution ownership and Run status to defer the new assignee; the race regression directly exercises the conditional database UPDATE shape used to cancel a stale queued holder.
units.keyDataModels: Issue assigneeAgentId versus executionRunId/executionAgentNameKey/executionLockedAt, holder HeartbeatRun queued/running/cancelled state and error code, original/new AgentWakeupRequest status, and requested actor metadata.
units.lifecycle: If Work is already running under the previous Agent after reassignment, the new Agent wake is persisted as deferred and the current Run/lock is left untouched; for a holder observed queued, cancellation is conditional on that exact status, so a concurrent queued-to-running claim prevents cancellation and retains the holder and Issue lock.
units.testAssessment: Two focused database tests cover running-holder deferral and a compare-on-status race guard. They do not cover the actual queued-holder cancellation through heartbeatService, promotion of the deferred new assignee, terminal handoff, process/Connector cancellation acknowledgment, session/tool/token revocation, workspace ownership, evidence preservation, reassignment authorization, repeated/ABA state transitions, distributed fencing, transaction/outbox crash points, timeout or old Agent completion after reassignment. The race is simulated by issuing the production-shaped UPDATE manually rather than interleaving service transactions.
units.designRationale: Avoid concurrent Agents executing the same Issue and prevent a reassignment cleanup path from clobbering a Run that another worker has just claimed.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must transfer responsibility and execution authority between Agents or humans without double execution, stale credentials, lost evidence or ambiguity over whether the previous attempt may finish.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the compare-and-set guard and deferred successor queue, but model reassignment as a versioned HandoffDecision. Use a fenced ExecutionLease generation bound to Work, responsibility contract, Agent, permissions/data contract and runtime attestation; select an explicit policy to let-finish, cancel-and-wait or force-revoke, require Connector acknowledgment/timeout, revoke runtime capabilities, freeze evidence, and only then activate the successor. Persist immutable requested/approved/effective handoff receipts through a transaction/outbox.
units.responsibilityConflict: The Issue assignee already points to Reviewer while Coder continues executing, with no accountable-human handoff decision or indication whether old authority remains valid. The requestedBy user is not authorization-tested, the running holder's capabilities are not revoked, and mutable row/status predicates provide concurrency safety but not responsibility-chain continuity or external-runtime fencing.
